## About our Miami, FL PetSmart Grooming Salon

Our Pet Stylists are ready to help dogs and cats in Miami look and feel their best. Every appointment benefits from our Pet Stylists' academy training and over 800 hours of hands-on experience, whether it's a bath, a full groom, or a haircut tailored to any breed. Even the most matted coats can come back in shape with our de-shedding treatments, and specially formulated shampoos and conditioners help soothe and improve skin and coat throughout. Walk-ins off N Miami Ave are welcome for quicker needs like nail grind, teeth brushing, and ear cleaning. Our salon in Midtown is a reliable stop for dog grooming in Miami, and we also offer Seasonal Specials and complete spa packages so every pet in your household has an option. Our Pet Stylists can also recommend the right products to take home, so your pet stays looking good between appointments. Our goal is simple: your dog or cat leaves our salon looking and feeling their best.

About Us

## A Family Business Built on Love & Care for Pets

We are a family-owned business that has served Miami since 1999. Luis and Neddy Salas founded Lovely Pets Grooming Salon, and Luis is a certified veterinary assistant, so every groom is done with a trained eye for your dog’s skin, ears and overall health.

We treat every dog with compassion as if they were our own. Many of our clients have trusted us for generations thanks to our consistent quality and care.

We have extensive experience with many breeds including Rottweiler, Chow, Presa Canario, Doberman, Akita, Pitbulls, American Bulldog, Dogo Argentino, Cane Corso, and more.

No matter your dog’s breed, we are ready to provide the best care possible.

*   Skilled professionals delivering precise, breed-specific grooming with attention to detail.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Quick answers about grooming, prices and visiting our Miami salon.

Do you accept walk-ins?

Yes. Walk-ins are welcome Tuesday to Saturday before 2:00 PM. After 2 PM we still try to fit you in, depending on how busy the day is and your dog's size, breed and age. To guarantee a time, [book online](https://app.squareup.com/appointments/buyer/widget/58ofmt4ag2foao/0K01964HXWGMH) or call (305) 476-8980.

Can I walk in just for a nail trim?

Yes. Nail trims with Dremel or file are walk-in, Tuesday to Saturday before 2:00 PM, no appointment needed. We also do quick walk-in ear cleaning, anal gland expression and sanitary trims. See prices on our [Services page](https://lovelypetsgroomingsalon.com/services/).

How much does dog grooming cost?

A full groom starts at $85 for small and medium dogs and goes up to $185 for giant breeds. The final price depends on your dog's size, coat condition and behavior. You can see every price on our [Services page](https://lovelypetsgroomingsalon.com/services/).

Will I be charged extra without being told?

No. If your dog needs something extra, like treatment for a skin or ear problem, fleas or ticks, or severe matting, we explain it before we start, or we call you to approve it first.

Do you offer pickup and delivery?

Yes. We pick up and drop off dogs at home Thursday through Saturday, across most of Miami, including Coconut Grove and Coral Gables. We also offer weekly packages. Pricing depends on distance and breed, so call us to confirm your area.

Is your dog hotel cage-free?

Yes. We have run a cage-free dog hotel since 2009. Dogs stay without crates or cages, cared for by the same team that grooms them.

Do you groom senior dogs?

Yes. Tuesdays and Wednesdays are our Senior Dog Days, with a calm environment, priority attention and a call 20 minutes before pickup so older dogs wait as little as possible.

Are you open on holidays?

Our regular hours are Tuesday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Holiday closures and special hours are posted on our Google Business Profile and social media, so please check
